# Calphy sUF spline tables

This directory vendors `calphy/splines.py` and the upstream license from
ICAMS/calphy commit:

`a2c24dd8a2472a4bef468c0389084a749c2485c3`

Upstream: <https://github.com/ICAMS/calphy>

The table file documents that the spline coefficients originate from the
supplemental material for the Uhlenbeck-Ford reference-system work by Leite,
Freitas, Azevedo, and de Koning. The files are kept verbatim so analytic sUF
free energies can be reproduced without network access.
